triggers.text: Still ringing in my ears. Best night in years. Come by the villa. Bring coffee.
triggers.note: The Red Dirt concert and his mixed feelings about Johnny.

triggers.text: You keep showing up. That's rare. Don't ruin it.
triggers.note: The level title. He makes a joke about being liked.

triggers.text: Thursday. Riot club. I need a drinking partner who doesn't want an autograph.
triggers.note: The Riot club quest, Us Cracks, and his love of low-key venues.

triggers.text: I can see you from the balcony. Come in. Stop loitering.
triggers.partnerText: I can see you from the balcony, you gorgeous loiterer. Come in.
triggers.note: North Oak, his villa, and coffee.

triggers.text: That's my song. Ha. Were you listening, or did the radio decide?
triggers.note: The song title comes from the radio. He does not quote lyrics and he is ambivalent about it.

triggers.text: Last night was good. Don't overthink it. Overthink it a little.
triggers.note: The marina, the relationship with V, and his bisexuality as a plain fact.

triggers.text: You alright? You look like hell. Come have a coffee.
triggers.note: V's recent fight. He checks that V is all right, and he is blunt.

triggers.text: That was strange. Good strange. Let's do it again someday.
I need strings. And a witness. North Oak, the little shop with the bad sign.
triggers.partnerText: I need strings. And a witness. North Oak, the little shop with the bad sign. Come with me, darling.
triggers.note: A blind guitar match in a North Oak instrument shop, where you pick the guitar that sounds warm and sad.

triggers.text: Beach. Sunset. We're making a fire out of garbage. You'll love it.
triggers.partnerText: Beach. Sunset. We're making a fire out of garbage. You'll love it, and I'll love having you there.
triggers.note: A driftwood fire on the Pacifica beach at sunset.

triggers.text: I'm starving. Staff is asleep. Come sneak with me.
triggers.partnerText: I'm starving. Staff is asleep. Come raid the kitchen with me.
triggers.note: A night raid on the fridge at his North Oak villa while the staff sleep.

triggers.text: Old pier. Great echo. Bring your voice. Not for singing.
triggers.partnerText: Old pier. Great echo. Bring your voice. Not for singing. I just want to hear it.
triggers.note: An old pier at Pacifica with a great echo, and the shouting he likes there.

triggers.text: Neighbour's party. Not invited. We're going as plus-ones. You're my cousin.
triggers.partnerText: Neighbour's party. Not invited. We're going as plus-ones. You're my date this time.
triggers.note: A neighbour's garden party in North Oak that he was not invited to, where V is his cousin.
